must_fail.note: Updated for amendment A-S2-2 (S2_SPEC §6): a call to an unregistered tool (dailylife/mystery_tool is not in the suite manifest) is no longer an integrity failure; it is kept, ineligible for M-S1, regex impact for B-prov.
